# 2. Related Literature

Our paper builds on the agency view of the firm. (Jensen and Meckling, 1976) argue that outside equity creates a conflict between managers and shareholders, and later work follows (Shleifer and Vishny, 1997) in treating large shareholders as the remedy. The asset-pricing literature measures the cost of that conflict with factor models. See Eugene F. Fama & Kenneth R. French, Common Risk Factors in the Returns on Stocks and Bonds, 33 J. Fin. Econ. 3, 5 (1993). Earlier tests of the same idea used event studies [14], and Fama & French, supra, at 8, extend them to bonds.
